tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 57)༄༅/nyams snang las lhag pa'i lha la gsol 'debs thugs rgyud gnas bskul bzhugs/58)kye ma/dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus 'dus pa'i sku/ /'gro ba'i mag
57)༄༅/nyams snang las lhag pa'i lha la gsol 'debs thugs rgyud gnas bskul bzhugs/58)kye ma/dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus 'dus pa'i sku/ /'gro ba'i mag

tei:div.tei:p: 57) ༄༅/ nyams snang las lhag pa'i lha la gsol 'debs thugs rgyud gnas bskul bzhugs/ 58)kye ma/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus 'dus pa'i sku// 'gro ba'i mgon gyur 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// 'jigs brgyad zhi mdzad rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol// bdag sogs rtse gcig dad pas gsol ba 'debs// thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir// snying po dam pa'i chos la mi brtson zhing*// don med stong log mi dge'i las la brtson// gsol ba 'debs so 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// thugs rjes zungs shig ār+ya tā re ma// mi lus don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs// phyi snod 'jig rten nang bcud 'gro ba sogs// mi rtag chu yi lbu ba dang mtshungs kyang*// 'chi chos mi sgrub rtag 'dzin dam pos bcings// gsol ba= thugs rjes= 'chi ba snying nas dran par byin= srid pa'i bde sdug las 'bras kho nar thug /spang blang gnyis la blang dor nor nas kyang*// rgyu 'bras khyad gsod stong skad kha pho mtho// gsol ba= thugs rjes= rgyu 'bras bag las zhib par= 'khor ba'i gnas su bde ba 59)skad cig med// bde ba 'dod kyang sdug bsngal las la brtson// phye lheb ji bzhin me 'obs nang du 'gags// gsol ba= thugs rjes= 'khor ba zhen pa log par= mchog gsum skyabs gnas gtso bo yin na'ang*// bslab pa'i sdom pa sna gcig mi bsrung zhing*// mi dge'i las brtson nyes ltung sna tshogs bsags// gsol ba= thugs rjes= dkon mchog yon tan dran par= smon 'jug byang sems nor bu yod na yang*// gzhan phan chung bas gnyis 'dzin ru trar gol// gsol ba= thugs rjes= tshad med rnam bzhi skye bar= bdag 'dzin med snyam tshogs gnyis 'khor lor rloms// ser sna dam pos tshogs bsags mi brtson zhing*/ ja phor tsam la rang gzhan shi sbar 'thams// gsol ba= thugs rjes=

tshogs bsags rgya cher nus par= sdig sgrib med snyam rang snang stong par bzung*// dad zas gshin zas dkor nag khur po lci// gsol ba= thugs rjes= stobs bzhi rgyud la skye bar= dad pa dag snang phyogs med bsam na yang*// jo dar rlung gis bskyod dang mtshungs pas 60)na// gsol ba= thugs rjes= dad mos thang lhod med par= rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin gsum ldan la// mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog mi bsgrub par// log sgrib dbang gis mtshams med nyes ltung bsags// gsol ba= thugs rjes= mnyes pa phul du phyin par= bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med par// dbang bzhi blang ba phyogs dang ris su chad// byin rlabs 'jug dka' log lta skyes nas kyang*// bla ma dgra ltar mthong nas skur pa 'debs// gsol ba= thugs rjes= bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug nas kyang*// sangs rgyas dngos su mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// lta ba mthon pos nam mkha' mdung bskor byed// rgyu 'bras khyad gsod stong skad chad ltar gol// rang gzhan phung byed sdig pa'i las la brtson// gsol ba= thugs rjes= lta ba'i rang skyon mthong bar byin= sgom pa 'dzin med chos skur grol snyam bshad// a 'thas 'dzin zhen brtod phur dam pos bzung*// 'khor ba blo yis mi thongs rim gyis brtson// gsol ba= thugs rjes= gzung 'dzin mdud pa zhig par byin= theg chen spyod pa yid bzhin nor bu la// gang shar 61) rang grol spang blang med na yang*// blo chung theg dman 'dor zhig tshul khrims nyams// gsol ba= thugs rjes= bslab pa gsum dang ldan par byin= rang byung ye shes lkog 'gyur lung ma bstan// gsal stong nyams la zhen nas rang nyid bslus// gsol ba= thugs rjes= rang byung ye shes rtogs par byin= lam la sbyang rtsol mi dgos lhun grub la// gnyis 'dzin chags sdang gdung sems drag pos bsdams// gsol ba= thugs rjes= lam la gol 'phyugs bral bar byin=

'bras bu kun bzang dgongs pa 'od gsal dbyings/ khyad chos drug ldan gzhon nu bum pa'i sku// spros pa'i mtha' brgyad ma chod dug lngas zin// gsol ba= thugs rjes= sku bzhi'i rgyal sa zin par byin= mdor na bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// 'khor bar blo ldog bla ma dam pa brten// bslab pa gsum dang theg pa so so yi// mdo sngags gzhung lugs khyad chos sna tshogs sogs// ma lus thams cad ma nor rim bzhin du// dka' ba dang blangs ngal ba khyad bsad nas// bdag cag brtson 'grus drag pos nyams blang zhing*// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyi grub pa dang*/ 62)/ma rig dug lnga'i gnyen por gyur nas kyang*// bdag rgyud smin grol snod du rung bar shog /rang rgyud grol nas gzhan phan byang sems la// 'phags pa nyid dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs// gal te las rlung drag po'i mthu btsan pas// ma rig nyon mongs dbang du gyur na yang*// rgyal ba'i yum mchog 'phags ma sgrol ma yis// dug lnga grogs su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// bdag la bzang ngan 'brel thogs ma lus pa// phyi ma 'og min po ta la yi zhing*// ma dang dbyer med 'phags pa'i zhabs drung du// tshom bu gcig tu mngon par sangs rgyas shog ces gsol 'debs 'di yang 'khor ba nyams len byed pa'i sprang mo skyon kun ldan pa bdag gis 'phags mchog gangs ri'i mgon po dang rgyal ba'i yul mchog gnyis kyi 'od zer cung zad mjal ba la brten nas/ gsol 'debs smon lam gyi tshul du rang gzhan la phan pa'i sems kyis kalpa la bha dra tā re'am de wa'i ming gis/ rmi lam 'khrul snang la brten nas bris pa ste/ mkhas pa rnams kyis gzigs na thugs khrel rgyu// rang la mos pa rnams kyis 'di la gzigs// ne tso 'ug pa gnyis kyi dpe dang mtshungs// sprang mo tā re'i ming gis shog brdzad yin// sems can thams cad g.yu lo bkod du skyes/

63)/tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sku gnyis thob par shog dge'o// ༈ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel bsam pa myur 'grub bzhugs: e ma ho: spros bral chos dbyings chen po'i zhing khams nas: skye 'gags 'gyur med rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bad chad zhi ba dang: bsam don lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gnas skabs 'phral rkyen ngan pa kun sel nas: mthar thug sa lam bar chad mi 'byung zhing: rnga yab zangs mdog dpal rir skye bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pa brgya stong khri sogs bzla: sa lam bar chad kun sel nas: bsam don ma lus 'grub par nges: tshig nyung don 'dus zab pa'i chosaḥ dregs pa rnam gsum gter gyis shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: ḍā ki'i rgya: ces pa'ang bar chad lam sel 'di yang dge btsun dharma'i ming can gyi ngor su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa'o// 64) e ma hoḥ rang rig ma bcos pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rang gsal 'dzin med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: rang byung ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ces bde ba'i rdo rjes so// e ma hoḥ sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo wa ra hiḥ ye shes sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs rig pa 'dzin: sbas pa'i rnal 'byor su kha badz+ra la: rang rig 'du 'bral med par gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med rjes bzung nas: 'od gsal gnas lugs rtogs pa mngon gyur cing: rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ces pa 'di yang shī la'i mtshan 'chang gis yang yang bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du snyom las pa mdo med 'chol mo pā shaṃ ming gis bris pa'o// ༈ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: gsol 'debs thugs rjes myur 'dzin 'od gsal rang grol bzhugs: e ma hoḥ kun bzang rdor 'chang rdor sems dga' rab rje:

shrī seng 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bi ma la: pad+ma 'byung gnas ye shes mtsho rgyal dang: bai ro lang gro nam mkha'i snying po sogs: dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs: thugs 65)rgyud byin rlabs snying la 'phos nas kyang: rang rig ma bcos ye shes mngon gyur nas: ka dag spros bral rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: gnyug ma'i rang sa zin par= gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig par= blo 'das 'od gsal rig pa byang chub sems: sku bzhi'i bdag nyid ngo bo mthar son te: lhun grub rang gdangs nyams len rtsal rdzogs nas: chos zad blo 'das gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su: 'khrul bral ye shes chen po'i sa thob shog: 'di la rgyun du brtson nus na: ye shes rang zhal mngon gyur nas: gdod ma'i gtan srid zin par nges: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: : ces pa 'di yang dad ldan blo sher gyis yang yang nan cher bskul ngor 'chol mo bde ba'i rdo rjes chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong nas dag par phabs pa'o// dge'o// kye ma/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid rgyal ba 'od dpag med// ye shes spyan ldan rgyal sras byang chub sems// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// byi la rigs drug gnas nas drang du gsol// pad+ma 'byung gnas ye shes mtsho rgyal ma// lang gro lo tsā bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling*// bdag gis mos gus 66)gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// byi la rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol// kun mkhyen gnyis pa dri med 'od zer dang*// pad+ma ma ti rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// byi la ngan song sdug bsngal drag po las// thar nas rnam mkhyen lam sna zin pa dang*// bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs// gal te bde chen zhing du ma skyes na// gnas ngan gcong rong 'jigs las thar nas kyang*// mthar thug 'phags pa'i zhabs drung skye bar shog ces pa 'di yang byi la rigs drug gi sdug bsngal myong ba'i dus su rang nyid snying rje bzod blag med pa'i mchi ma byung ba'i dus phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang rang gi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la 'o dod kyi tshul du tā re'i ming gis bris pa byi la rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog

dge'o// e ma hoḥ rang snang rnam dag don gyi 'og min naḥ rgyal kun yum gyur rnal 'byor wā ra hi: ye shes sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur rig pa 'dzin: sbas pa'i tshul 'chang su kha badz+ra la: rnam gsum dad pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs: blo ldog bzhi yis rang rgyud grol nas kyang: 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i gnas las rab ldog ste: tshe 67)'dir don gnyis yid bzhin 'grub pa dang: khyad par gsang sngags rim gnyis gnad smin nas: mthar thug 'od gsal rdzogs chen mngon gyur shog: ces dad ldan bso gcod kyi ngor sprang 'khyams su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa'o// e ma hoḥ skye med chos sku'i dbyings na kun bzang mo: 'gags med rang byung rdor rje rnal 'byor ma: thugs rje kun khyab dzñā na sā ga ra: dbyer med ye shes sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur ba: bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med rjes bzung nas: las rkyen ngan pa'i dbang du mi 'gro zhing: blo sna chos la 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol: ces pa'ang dad ldan skyid lha'i ngor su badz+ra gyis bris pa'o// e ma hoḥ ngo bo ka dag 'od gsal chos kyi sku: rang bzhin ma 'gags rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: thugs rje'i bdag nyid dzñā na sā ga ra: ye shes sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur rig pa 'dzin: sbas pa'i rnal 'byor su kha badz+ra laḥ rnam gsum dad pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med rjes bzung ste: bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol: 68)khyad par bskyed rdzogs gnad la rab goms nas: 'od gsal rdzogs chen rig pa mngon gyur te: ka dag kun tu bzang por byang chub shog: ces pa 'di yang dad ldan dge btsun phrin las bzang pos dar bcas nan cher bskul ngor sprang 'khyams bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// e ma hoḥ sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo wā ra hi: ye shes sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur rig pa 'dzin: sbas pa'i tshul 'dzin su kha badz+ra la:

sgo gsum dad pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med thugs rjes zungs: blo ldog rnam bzhis rang rgyud legs grol nas: rim pa gnyis kyi lam mchog mngon gyur te: rnga yab zangs mdog dpal rir skye bar shog: ces pa 'di yang 'dus sde rgya mtsho'i bzhed skong du dus mtha'i gter ming 'dzin pa bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// e ma hoḥ rig dbyings mi 'gyur 'od gsal 'dus ma byas: lhun grub gdangs las ye shes rol pa'i gar: rdo rje phag mo dzñā na sā ga ra: dbyer med rnal 'byor su kha badz+ra la: rang rig 'du 'bral med par gsol ba 'debs: tshe rabs kun tu rjes su bzung 69) nas kyang: 'od gsal rdzogs chen dgongs pa mngon gyur nas: tshe 'dir don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ces pa'ang wa shul mi dbang dad ldan grags rgyal gyi ngor bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// e ma hoḥ rnam dag rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dpal: rnam kun mchog ldan pad+ma las 'brel rtsal: kun bzang dbang mo bde ba'i rdo rje la: sgo gsum dad pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs: 'khrul snang bar do'i 'jigs skrag mi 'byung zhing: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med rjes bzung nas: kun bzang pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs drung du: ston 'khor tshom bu gcig tu 'khod par shog: ces pa 'di yang dad ldan rig 'dzin gyis bskul ngor su kha badz+ra gyis so// e ma ho: skye med dbyings yum bde chen kun bzang mo: 'gags med rang byung rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: kun khyab rang gsal dzñā na sā ga ra: ye shes sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur rig pa 'dzin: bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med rjes bzung nas: bsam don 70)chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol: ces pa'ang dad ldan rin chen don 'grub kyi ngor su kha badz+ra gyis so// e ma hoḥ bde chen mgon po snang mtha' yas:

pad dkar 'chang ba spyan ras gzigs: byin rlabs ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: rgyal yum 'phags ma tā re ma: dbyer med su kha badz+ra la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pa yis: rtse gcig dad pas gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: blo sna rtag tu chos la bsgyur: yang dag bde chen sa thob shog: ces pa 'di yang dad ldan mdo sngags rgya mtshos bskul ngor su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa'o// ༈ bla ma rgyang 'bod thugs rje'i 'od zer bzhu+ugs: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo: thos grol dam chos kyi 'byung gnas: 'dren ston dge 'dun gyi rje bo: mchog gsum kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid: pad+ma las 'brel de mkhyen noḥ thugs rjes myur du yang gzigs nas: bdag rgyud byin gyis rang rlobs shig: byin rlabs yongs 'dus kyi bla ma: dngos grub kun 'byung gi yi dam: bar chad sel mdzad kyi mkha' 'gro: rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo: pad+ma las 'brel= thugs rje= bdag rgyud= 71)skye med chos sku yi ngo bo: 'gags med gsal khyab kyi rang bzhin: thugs rje kun snang gi bdag nyid: sku gsum yongs 'dus kyi rgya mtsho: pad+ma las 'brel= thugs rjes= bdag rgyud= 'das pa'i rgyal kun gyi rgyal tshab: ma 'ongs rgyal kun gyi spyi dpalaḥ da lta'i rgyal kun gyi ngo bo: dus gsum rgyal ba yi rgyal tshab: pad+ma las 'brel= thugs rjes = bdag rgyud= thar pa'i lam ston gyi ded dpon: ma rig mun sel gyi sgron me: gzung 'dzin gcod byed kyi ral gri: sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi sman mchog: rang rig don ston gyi bla ma: bka' drin mtshungs med kyi 'gro mgon: pad+ma las 'brel rtsal= thugs rjes= bdag rgyud= sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo: thugs gsang dam chos kyi gter mdzod: ye shes sgyu ma yi sku brnyes: bdag gi 'dren ston gyi bla ma: pad+ma las 'brel rtsal= 'di phyi bar gsum du 'bral med: rjes bzung smin grol gyi lam mchog:

gang 'dod dgos skal chos stsal nas: don gnyis lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas: da lta mngon sum du thob par: rje btsun bla ma khyed mkhyen 72)no: zhes pa'ang rig 'dzin chen po'i dngos slob yongs kyi tha shal ba su kha badz+ra gyis yid skyo bas byed thabs dang bral yang bla ma la 'o dod 'bod pa'i tshul du bris nas shī la badz+ra la phul// dge'o// skye ba kun tu pad+ma las 'brel dang: 'bral med zab chos dpal la longs spyod cing: sa dang lam bgrod rim par ma ltos shing: kun bzang pad 'byung rje dang dbyer med par: rnga yab pad+ma 'od du skye bar shog: ces dge btsun chos gsal ngor gang gi 'bangs su gyur pa kun gyi tha shal ba su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa'o// ༈ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: gsol 'debs yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs: e ma hoḥ skye med chos sku'i zhing na kun bzang mo: 'gags med longs sku'i zhing na wā ra hi: kun khyab sprul sku'i zhing na mtsho rgyal ma: sku gsum ngo bo bde bskyed gsang ba'i yum: bde chen 'gyur med bde ba'i rdo rje la: 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: mi gnas ye shes thugasakyi dkyil 'khor nas: rang byung bde ba chen po'i rang zhal sprod: 'gyur med sku yi byin rlabs lus la stsolaḥ lus 73)la bde chen ye shes sbar du gsol: 'gags med gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la stsol: ngag la yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan stsol: 'khrul bral thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la stsol: yid la rtsol bral ye shes bskyed du gsol: yon tan phrin las bdag rgyud la zhugs nas: zab gter sgo 'phar smin grol rim gnyis kyi: mdzad pa mthar phyin bstan 'gro'i don byed shog: skye ba kun tu su kha badz+ra dang: 'bral med bde ba'i dpal la longs spyod nas: kha sbyor bdun ldan dag pa ye sangs rgyas: chos nyid don gyi rnal 'byor mngon gyur nas: dbyer med 'og min zhing la spyod par shog:

dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs dang: chos nyid ka dag don dam bden pa dang: mkha' spyod dbang mo'i thugs rje'i nus pa yis: smon don myur du ma lus 'grub par mdzod: ces pa'ang gsang grogs chos kyi bdag po bi ma la'i bzhed skong du mdo med 'chol mo pradzñā'i ming gis bris pa'o// ka nas dag pa gzhi'i rdo rje// mi 'gyur bde chen ye shes sku// dga' ba bzhi 74)yi rang gzugs gar// lhan skyes pho nya'i dbang phyug mo// rnal 'byor kun gzigs sgyu ma'i 'phrul// skad cig mi 'bral bde stong lam// thabs shes sbyor ba'i rten 'brel las// mngon gyur rlung sems dbu mar thim// snang srid brda dang dpe char shar// zab gter gnyis la mnga' dbang 'byor// pad+ma'i phrin las mthar phyin nas// rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams su*// tshom bu gcig tu 'khod par shog e ma ho/ ye stong spros dang bral ba'i mkha' dbyings su// mdun mkhar chos nyid mngon sum snang ba'i zhing*// nyams snang gong 'phel gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs// rig pa tshad phebs rje btsun rnal 'byor ma// chos zad blo 'das su kha badz+ra rtsal// mnyam nyid bde stong chen por gsol ba 'debs// snang stong lhun grub rol pa mthar phyin nas// rig stong dbyer med chen po'i sa la sbyor// gsal stong 'gag pa med pa'i ye shes nyid// mngon gyur dang po'i 'od gsal gding thob ste/ rang rig mi 'gyur gtan srid rab zin nas/ nang gsal gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas shog de skad dge btsun tshe 'phel 75)gyis bskul ngor// kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos yi ger bris// dge'o// e ma hoḥ sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo wā ra hi: ye shes sgyu ma'i skur snang rig pa 'dzin: rnal 'byor bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje la: rnam gsum dad pa chen pos gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyir bar gsum 'bral med rjes bzung nas: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar zhi ba dang:

bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ces pa dad ldan sngags btsun dam pa'i ngor/ su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa'o// e ma hoḥ gzhi dbyings 'gyur med rdzogs pa chen po'i klong: sku dang ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin pa: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rang rig 'du 'bral med par gsol ba 'debs: rang sems 'khrul pa'i dbang du mi 'khyams par: rig pa 'od gsal ye shes don rtogs nas: o rgyan chen po'i zhabs drung skye bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pa brgya stong la sogs bzla: sa ma ya: ces pa'ang su kha badz+ra gyis brdzun ris su bris pa'o// e ma ho/ rang rig ma bcos 76)gnyug ma'i ye shes rtsal/ khyab brdal phyogs mtha' bral ba'i rang bzhin du/ rigs bdag bla ma'i ngo bor yongs shar ba// rang rig dbyer med gu ru pad+ma la// rang sems ma bcos dad pas gsol ba 'debs// rang byung ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ ces sprang mo'i rdzun ris so// a hoḥ rang rig ma bcos khyab brdal: 'od gsal snang ba ye shes: spros pa'i mtha' brgyad bral ba: gnas lugs ngang du skyong mdzod: ha haḥ e ma hoḥ gzhi dbyings rnam dag 'od gsal pho brang nas: gzhi snang ma 'gags lhun grub bkod pa ngoms: gzhi rtsal rig stong pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: gzhi klong mi 'gyur mtsho rgyal 'bangs nyer lngar: rang rig 'du 'bral med par gsol ba 'debs: rang sems ma bcos 'od gsal mngon gyur nas: rang byung ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: rang gnas chos sku'i gtan srid zin pa dang: 'di phyi'i mi mthun rgud pa kun bsal nas: bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de ltar rgyun du gsol ba btab nus na: bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par the tshom med: de skad thugs sras bskul 77)ba zab phyir du// bskal bzang 'dus sde rgya mtsho'i bzhed skong phyir// ma nus sprang 'khyams su kha badz+ra gyis// dgongs pa mi 'gyur brda las bris pa dge/

dge'o// e ma hoḥ rang rig 'gyur med bde chen pho brang nas: rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: gang 'dul sprul pa'i rnam rol mtsho rgyal mar: gsol 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: de ltar gsol btab byin rlabs kyis: bar chad kun zhi bsam pa 'grub: the tshom med do sa ma ya: ces pa 'di yang sprul pa'i sku rat+na dang 'dus sde rnams kyis dar bcas bka' bskul phebs tshe sprang 'khyams mdo med 'chol mo su kha badz+ra ram/ ga ga bha dras brda las bsgyur ba'o// e ma hoḥ sku gsum rigs 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbyings yum mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 78)e ma ho: ka dag spros bral chos sku kun bzang mo: lhun grub rang gdangs longs sku wa ra hi: thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku mtsho rgyal ma: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i phrin las rol pa'i gar: zab gter mdzod 'dzin sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ma: kun bzang bde skyong dbang mor gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyi kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung nas: smin grol rim gnyis zab mo mthar phyin mdzod: rig stong dbyer med rdo rje rnal 'byor mas: dbugs dbyung lung bstan brtse bas rjes bzung nas: ma dag sgyu lus lha sku'i phyag rgyar dag: rtsa thig rlung gsum 'od gsal bcud du smin: rang rig mi 'gyur rdzogs pa mthar phyin nas: nang gsal gzhon nu bum skur grol bar shog: mdor na 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du: las rkyen ngan pa'i dbang du mi 'gro zhing: rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab bcud rol nas: dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs nus shog: skye ba kun tu bla ma yab yum dang: 'bral med zab chos bdud rtsi'i dpal la spyod: mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog phul phyin nas: rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog:

bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs sems can 79)kun: phyi ma 'og min dag pa'i zhing khams su: rig 'dzin yab yum gnyis dang dbyer med par: 'khor gyi thog mar bdag sogs skye bar shog: skyes nas theg chen chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed: 'bras bu'i chos dang ye shes yon tan rgyas: rang rig kun tu bzang por sangs rgyas nas: gzhon nu bum sku'i gtan srid zin par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ཿ ces pa'ang sprul pa'i sku mchog 'jigs med kyis bskul ngor/ mdo med 'chol mo su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa'o// e ma hoḥ chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i pho brang nas: lhun grub 'gyur med rgyal kun brtse ba'i yum: rnal 'byor wā ra hi dang dbyer med pa: gsang 'dzin rnal 'byor bde ba'i rdo rje la: rang rig gnyis med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med rjes bzung nas: nyon shes sgrib pa dag par byin gyis rlobs: ces pa'ang chos mchog gi ngor/ sprang su kha'i ming gis brdzun ris su bris pa'o// mi mthun phyogs zhi mthun rkyen rgyas: mos pa dbang 'dus dgra bgegs thul: yid la 'dod pa'i 80)las rnams kun: bdag gis myur du 'grub par mdzod: ces so// ༈ kun gzhi spros pa bral ba'i klong yangs nas: kun mkhyen yab sras brgyud 'dzin dpa' bo mchog: kun bzang thugs kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur: kun gyi rje bo bla ma rin po che: kun gzhi ma bcos ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: kun snang rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs: ces sprang mo'i mtshar gtam mo// e ma hoḥ sangs rgyas kun 'dus rgyal sras pad+ma 'byung: thugs kyi rnal 'phrul bdu 'dul dbang phyug gling: rigs sras gsung 'dzin 'jigs med dpa' bo'isku: dkon mchog kun 'dus 'gro ba'i dpal du shar: rgyas sras byang chub sems dpar gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med rjes bzung nas: don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs:

ces pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang skyes mchog dam pa thub bstan bzang po dang btsun ma rnams kyi bzhed skong du bha dra'i ming gis bris pa dge'o// e ma ho: rgyal ba kun yum bde chen dkar: rnal 'byor gar bsgyur ye shes sku: 'gyur med yun du brtan nas kyang: mdzad pa phrin las mthar rgyas shog: 81)ces dad dam 'chang ba'i ngor de wa'i ming gis bris pa'o// e ma hoḥ rgyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus rje btsun ma'i: sgyu 'phrul sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bde ba'i mtshan: 'gro kun bu bzhin skyong ba'i ma gcig pu: 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur dzñā na sā ga ra: ma mo mkha' 'gro yongs 'dus spyi dpal mchogaḥ sku tshe mi nub zhabs pad rab brtan nas: bstan pa'i gzhi bzung 'gro rnams smin grol 'god: yang gsang snying po'i bstan pa rab rgyas shog: ces pa 'di'ang dad ldan kalpa la'i ming gis nan cher bskul ngor de wa'i ming gi brdzun ris so// ༈ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: gsol 'debs dus ngan 'jigs skyob bsam pa myur 'grub ma bzhugs so: e ma ho: dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i dpal: sangs rgyas kun las thugs rje myur ba'i lha: 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon o rgyan rin po che: log 'dren tshar gcod rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: gdug pa 'dul mdzad yang khros gro bo lod: mi bzod dus kyi g.yul ngo 'gyed pa'i tshe: skyabs dang re 82)sa gzhan na ma mchis pas: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs kyis dgongs mdzod la: mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs mtshon gyi bskal pa bzlog: lo nyes sad ser mu ge'i 'jigs pa skyobs: mi phyugs la 'tshe nad dang sdug bsngal sol: rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin la gnod pa'i: rgya 'dre 'byung po mi dang mi min gdon: ma rungs bstan la 'tshe byed dam sri'i rigs: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu rtsal ma zhan par: thams cad bzlog cing 'dul ba'i dus la bab:

'di phyi'i mi mthun nyer 'tshe kun zhi nas: byang chub sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing: bsam don myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: rtse gcig 'di la brtson myur na: mi mthun rgud pa kun sel nas: 'jigs pa kun las skyob par nges: the tshom med do sa ma ya: skal ldan bu yi dpal du spyod: skal med rnams la gu h+ya rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: : zhes pa dad ldan dkon mchog gis yang yang bskul ngor dus mtha'i gter ming ma kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo'am bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las bsgyur ba yongs su 83)dge bar gyur cig// e ma ho: rang snang dag pa rnga yab dpal gyi zhing: rang byung bde chen pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rang rig 'du 'bral med par gsol ba 'debs: rang byung ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa'o// e ma ho: sku gsum yongs 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: thugs kyi rnam 'phrul pad+ma las 'brel rtsal: bde skyong ḍā ki su kha badz+ra la: 'bral med rtse gcig dad pas gsol ba 'debs: thugs rjes nam yang ma 'dor rjes 'dzin cing: smin grol lam bzang gdams pa'i chos stsal te: tshe 'dir don gnyis 'bras bu thob pa dang: phyi ma dpal ri pad+ma 'od gling du: yab rje o rgyan chen po'i zhabs drung du: tshom bu gcig tu ston 'khor dbyer med cing: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mdun bsus te: ma hā gu ru'i glu dbyangs sgra dang bcas: zhing mchog pad+ma 'od du skye bar shog: ces pa'ang rang slob pad+ma thub bstan bzang po dang rigs sras dbyangs can lha mos yang yang bskul ngor bde ba'i 84)rdo rjes bris pa'o// e ma ho: rgyal kun 'dus zhal pad+ma las 'brel rtsal: zung 'jug bde skyong mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhabs: rang rig 'du 'bral med par gsol ba 'debs:

'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med byin gyis rlobs: ces bde ba'i rdo rjes so// e ma ho: rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i: sgyu 'phrul sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bde ba'i mtshan: rang rig 'du 'bral med par gsol ba 'debs: 'od gsal rdzogs chen rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: dge'o// e ma ho: rang snang dag pa pad+ma 'od kyi gnas: rang byung lhun grub zhing khams ma lus rdzogs: rig pa'i ngo bo pad+ma rgyal po'i sku: ma bcos blo las 'das par gsol ba 'debs: ka dag spros bral rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: gnyug ma'i rang sa zin par byin gyis rlobs: 'od gsal gnas lugs lta ba mngon gyur nas: bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol: bde ba'i rdo rjes so// e ma ho: rang snang dag pa zangs mdog dpal gyi gnas: rang rig ma bcos o rgyan thod phreng rtsal: 85)rang gsal 'dzin med ngang du gsol ba 'debs: rang byung ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: bde ba'i rdo rjes so// e ma hoḥ bde stong 'du 'bral med pa'i gzhi klong nas: rgyal ba'i yum gyur dzñā na sa ga ra: rdo rje rnal 'byor ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo 'gro ba'i mgon: chos nyid don gzigs kun bzang dbang mo la: bdag ni gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs: lus la 'gyur med sku yi byin gyis rlobs: ngag la 'gag med gsung gi byin gyis rlobs: yid la 'khrul med thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: 'od gsal rdzogs chen dgongs pa mngon gyur nas: tshe 'dir 'chi ba'i lam la ma ltos par: ka dag lhun grub rim gnyis lam bsgoms mthus: gzhon nu bum skur 'ja' lus 'grub par shog: ces rang slob dad ldan mkhas dbang gis bskul ngor su kha badz+ra gyis so// e ma ho: rang rig don ston gtan gyis skabs gcig po: rig sku mngon gyur pad+ma las 'brel gyi: dgongs rgyud byin dang sku gsung thugs yon tan:

phrin las ma lus 86)bdag rgyud la zhugs nas: zab gter rgya mtsho smon lam 'phro ldan cing: bla ma'i bstan la bya ba byed nus shog: zhag la mi 'gyangs myur du 'grub pa ru: rtsa gsum mkha' 'gros mthu stobs rtsal phyungs mdzod: myur bar da lta gdan thog 'di nyid du: bla ma khyed dang 'byer med 'grub par shog: bla ma mkhyen: ces pa nyin bzhin stong rtsa re: ma chag rgyun du brtson gyur na: myur du bla ma rjes bzung nas: don gnyis 'grub par gdon mi za: pad+ma las 'brel mnog chos 'di: shī la badz+ra dpal du shog: sprang 'khyams su kha badz+ra gyis: 'khrul nyams yig ris bris pa dge: oṃ swa sti/ rtsa gsum srung ma'i bden mthu yis// rgyal sras sprul pa'i myu gu ni// bslab gsum 'bras bzang rab rgyas pa// rnyed nas don gnyis lhun grub shog /klong chen rab 'byams ye shes sgyu ma'i gar// bde gshegs rgyal ba'i thugs gsang mdzod 'dzin pa// o rgyan dngos snang pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// gzugs sku dbyings thim mya ngan 'das ston kyang*// slar yang thugs rje'i zlos gar sgyur ma'i sku// bdag cag rjes 'jug bstan 'gro'i 87) don ched du// ma 'gyangs myur du 'byon par mdzad du gsol// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// 'gro ga'adul gsang sngags gling dang mi 'bral zhing*/ rab dngos 'bring nyams tha na rmi lam du// zhal mjal gsung thos dgongs rgyud byin rlabs stsol// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab dbang 'byor nas// bla ma'i thugs kyi dgyes pa kun 'grub cing*// mthar thug ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med par// tshom bu gcig tu 'khod par mdzad du gsol/ ces pa'ang sprul pa'i sku mchog sna tshogs rang grol gyis bkra shis lha gos bcas bkas bskul son tshe 'khor 'bangs tha shal ba su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa smon 'dun yid bzhin du 'grub par myur cig dge'o// e ma ho/

sku gsum rigs 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// thugs kyi rnam 'phrul dpa' bo he ru ka /bstan pa'i sgron me dri med rgyal ba'i sras// 'gro ba'i mun sel 'od gsal 'od zer gyis// bstan 'gro'i mdzad phrin phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// sku tshe bskal pa'i bar du rab brtan nas// rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis 88)stsol/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ye dha rma=sogs/ swā hā/ ces pa 'di yang bsod nams dbang phyug gis bskul ngor ku sa li'i brdzun ris so// oṃ swa sti/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku// bdud sde 'joms mdzad phrin las dpal mnga' ba// mtsho skyes rdo rje'i gsang gsum yon tan 'dzin// 'jigs bral gzhom med rgyal kun 'dus pa'i dpal// ye shes gcig nyid du mar snang ba'i sku// rdo rje 'chang dngos rig 'dzin grub pa'i rje'i// sku tshe mi 'gyur zhabs pad rab brtan nas// mdzad pa phrin las phyogs mthar rgyas gyur cig /'chi med pad 'byung rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs rje yis// bdag cag lhag bsam rnam dag smon pa'i 'bras// bslu med yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// skye zhing skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du// dpal mgon bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab bsgrub nas// bskyed rjogs rim gnyis sa lam mthar phyin te// bstan 'gro'i phan bde ma lus yongs 'grub cing*// tshe 'dir gdod ma'i gtan srid zin par shog ces pa 'di yang rang slob dam pa khams ri bo che'i bla ma tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ 89)bkra shis tshe ring*/ 'gyur med tshul khrims/ bsam gtan rgya mtsho rnams kyis dri bral lha reg bcas bskul ngor/ kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos lhag bsam rnam par dag pas bla ma rin po che'i sku tshe zhabs pad brtan phyir dben gnas mkha' 'gro 'du gling nas/ zla drug pa'i tshes gnyis dge bar bris pa smon don yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/
